task.goal: An activity feed paginates records sorted by (timestamp, id). The current cursor is an array offset, so deleting an earlier row between pages skips a later row. Fix page(records, cursor, limit) in feed.py to use a stable opaque cursor based on the last returned key. Keep the return shape (items, next_cursor), reject malformed cursors and nonpositive limits, run tests and validate.
